moments.action: End credits crawl vendor and thanks lists over black with faint tyre-smoke trails, then stops scrolling and settles into static cards: the Panavision logo, Dolby/SDDS/DTS marks and the 2006 copyright line.
The credits cut to a blue MPAA card rating the picture PG-13 with the ratings web addresses, which then drops away to a fully black frame as the film ends.
